headline: Recommended a favorable report to the Legislative Council on the Whitney Center, Inc. easement modification at 200 Leeder Hill Drive.
summary: The meeting reviewed a proposal to modify two conservation easement agreements with Whitney Center, Inc. at 200 Leeder Hill Drive. The change reduces Conservation Easement B by 2,603 square feet for ADA-compliant sidewalks and parking lot improvements, and expands Conservation Easement A by 2,625 square feet. Members unanimously issued a favorable report to the Legislative Council.
decisions: Recommended a favorable report to the Legislative Council on the proposed easement modification for Whitney Center, Inc., unanimously.
Approved the July 28, 2026 meeting minutes as written, with all in favor.

decision_evidence.quote: Commissioner McDonagh moved to issue a favorable report to the Legislative Council, seconded by Commissioner Bond. All were in favor; the Commission unanimously issued a favorable report.
Commissioner Leckman moved to approve the minutes as written. Commissioner McDonagh seconded and all were in favor. The July 28, 2026, meeting minutes were approved as written.

August 17, 2026  
The Planning and Zoning Commission, Town of Hamden, held a hybrid Public Hearing and Regular 
Meeting on Tuesday, August 11, 2026 at 7:00p.m. The meeting was held in -person in the Legislative 
Council Chambers/Auditorium at Memorial Town Hall, 2372 Whitney Avenue, Hamden, CT    06518, 
and remotely via Town Zoom teleconferencing at https://hamden.zoom.us/j/82468227728. 
 
Commissioners in Attendance: In Person:  Michele Mastropetre (Chairman), Joseph McDonagh, 
Hannah Leckman, Barbara Andrews, Felicia Bond, 
Ronald Leonardo, Calvin DeMarsilis 
  
Staff in Attendance: In Person: Eugene Livshits (Town Planner), Christopher Soto 
(Assistant Town Planner), Maisie Albis (Commission 
Clerk) 
Via Zoom: Tim Lee (Assistant Town Attorney) 
  
Chairman Mastropetre called the meeting to order at 7:00p.m. The clerk read the agenda into the 
record. Members and staff introduced themselves.  
 
A. Public Comment Session 
 Chairman Mastropetre called for comments on matters within the purview of the Commission 
but not otherwise on the agenda. There were no comments made. The Chairman closed the public 
comment session.   
 
B. Regular Meeting 
 1. C.G.S. §8-24 Review #26-450 
Proposed Easement Modification Agreement for Whitney Center, Inc. 
Applicant: Town of Hamden 
Mr. Livshits read his staff report summarizing the proposal. He told the Commission that the 
Town is seeking to modify two conservation easement agreements with Whitney Center, Inc. at 
200 Leeder Hill Drive. The modified agreement would reduce Conservation Easement B by 
2,603 square feet to accommodate ADA-compliant sidewalks and improvements to the northern
Page 2 of 2 Planning and Zoning Commission 8.11.26 Minutes 
 
parking lot on the property. Conservation Easement A would be expanded by 2,625 square feet to 
offset that reduction, for a net gain of 22 square feet of conservation area.  
Mr. Livshits reported that the proposed parking lot improvements were granted de minimis 
approval by Wetlands Agent Tom V ocelli in 2024, and that the Planning and Zoning Department 
had approved a minor amendment to the relevant site plan in 2025. Both approvals were 
contingent on the modifications to the conservation areas.  
Mr. Livshits concluded with the Planning and Zoning Department’s recommendation that the 
Commission issue a favorable report to the Legislative Council regarding the proposed changes. 
Chairman Mastropetre asked how large the original easement was for Conservation Area A. 
Mr. Livshits consulted the site layout map to find that information for her. She also asked what 
purpose the easements served. Mr. Livshits stated that the easements create permanently 
protected conservation areas where development is prohibited. 
With no further questions, Chairman Mastropetre called for a motion. Commissioner 
McDonagh moved to issue a favorable report to the Legislative Council, seconded by 
Commissioner Bond. All were in favor; the Commission unanimously issued a favorable 
report. 
 
C. Old Business 
 1. Review of July 28, 2026, Public Hearing and Regular Meeting minutes 
Commissioner Leckman moved to approve the minutes as written. Commissioner 
McDonagh seconded and all were in favor. The July 28, 2026, meeting minutes were 
approved as written. 
 
D. Adjournment 
  
 
 
 
 
 
      
 Commissioner McDonagh moved to adjourn. Commissioner Leonardo seconded and all 
were in favor. Chairman Mastropetre adjourned the meeting at 7:10p.m.
